desc: B. 1978 - Curaçao Ailsa Anastatia is a multidisciplinary artist whose work is rooted in the landscapes of Curaçao and the wider Caribbean. Drawing inspiration from the Caribbean mondi, Anastatia creates layered works that reflect the forces that shape both landscapes and communities. title: Dominique Hunter
desc: B. 1987 - Guyana Dominique Hunter received her Diploma from the E.R. Burrowes School of Art in 2007 where she was awarded Best Graduating Student. Three years later her first solo exhibition, Introspection, was held at the National Gallery of Art, Castellani House. In addition to securing silver and bronze medals in Castellani House’s 7th and 8th Biennial National Drawing Competition (2008 and 2010 respectively), she secured a silver medal at the Guyana Visual Arts Competition and Exhibition in 2014, and a gold medal in 2019. Todd has dedicated significant time to collaborative, community-oriented projects that cultivate public engagement with art beyond commercial and tourism-driven spaces. title: Enrique Rivera Príncipe

In 2018, Rivera Príncipe decided to venture into tailoring at the Academia Serrant, exploring fashion as an artistic expression. title: Hannah Seucharan
desc: B. 2003 - Trinidad & Tobago Hannah Seucharan (b. 2003) is a contemporary artist from Trinidad and Tobago. While she works primarily in acrylics, her practice spans multiple mediums including digital art and drawing. Seucharan explores the complex nature of female sexuality within the Caribbean space. The female body is a dominant motif within her work, appearing in various stages of abstraction as she bridges the gap between beauty and horror. Her work seeks to subvert dominant stereotypes of Trinidadian identity by focusing on more intimate domestic spaces as the true root of culture. title: Torrijo Galeano Mateo
desc: B. 1989 - Dominican Republic Torrijo Galeano Reyes Mateo (1989) es un pintor e ilustrador nacido en San Juan de la Maguana, República Dominicana, y residente en Santo Domingo. Graduado de la Facultad de Artes de la Universidad Autónoma de Santo Domingo (UASD) en 2017, su práctica artística explora las relaciones entre paisaje, memoria, desplazamiento y pertenencia. A través de la pintura, el dibujo y la intervención en el espacio público, construye narrativas que dialogan con la experiencia humana, los territorios habitados y las transformaciones del entorno. title: Wendie Zahibo
desc: B. 1991 - Guadeloupe Wendie Zahibo is a multidisciplinary artist-researcher (poet, photographer, performer and collage artist) living and working between Guadeloupe and mainland France. title: Yéssica Montero
desc: B. 1998 - Dominican Republic Yéssica Montero (b. 1998, Bonao, Dominican Republic) is a visual artist working across drawing, painting, and sculpture. She regularly participates in group exhibitions and projects addressing gender, politics, and decolonial histories, and has exhibited in Switzerland, Brazil, and the Dominican Republic. In 2023, she was an artist-in-residence at Atelier Mondial (Basel, Switzerland) in collaboration with the Institute Art Gender Nature.
